title: 4 apps with a full-time job
summary:
I shipped 4 apps with a full-time job. Here's what nobody tells you.
RunLocke, DraftPokémon, VGC Team Report and Atlaria. Three of the four are Pokémon tools, because I built for a niche I was already in.
Three lessons, the TikTok numbers behind them, and a weekend plan to start your first one.
